prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Sign in redesign changes have proven helpful, winning 3 out of 8 tests.
Home new flow changes have proven helpful, winning 2 out of 7 tests.
Adoption layout changes have proven helpful, winning 1 out of 3 tests.
Finish hint, home wait info, and home notification changes showed no clear effect across all tests of those kinds.
Predictions were consistently too high across all round 1 tests.
Evidence is still thin for adoption copy, adoption hint, adoption incentive, adoption new_screen, adoption redesign, choose_path copy, choose_path layout, choose_path new_screen, choose_path redesign, finish layout, finish redesign, home redesign, sign_in copy, and sign_in reorder changes as they lack at least two agreeing tests.

Changes:
0: [adoption, new_screen] Custom pet validation review new screen: Insert a dedicated pet validation review screen before finalizing adoption so users can inspect rendered custom pet details. (why: Adoption conversion drops to 69.8% and support received 3 emails about custom pet creation failing or looking wrong.)
1: [finish, redesign] Desktop controls two-column finish screen redesign: Redesign the home intro finish screen into a two-column layout highlighting key desktop pet controls and tray interaction hints. (why: Finish stage drops to 64.8% and support received 3 emails about confusion on controlling, hiding, or talking to pets post-onboarding.)
2: [home, new_flow] Companion rendering animation preview sub-flow: Add an animated pet companion preview visual element during the waiting screen wait sequence. (why: The waiting step has a long mean time (2336s) and median of 201s, causing drop-offs while waiting for local desktop setup.)
3: [choose_path, copy] Path selection quick start clarity copy: Update headline and body on the path selection screen to explicitly compare instant preset adoption with custom photo creation. (why: Choose path screen has a high mean time of 514s, showing users hesitate when picking between creation options.)
4: [sign_in, hint] Sign in cloud save persistent hint: Display an explicit guidance hint on the sign-in screen explaining automatic companion syncing across device sessions. (why: 8 support emails complained about missing or reset pets after signing back in.)
5: [adoption, layout] Pick friend carousel layout redesign: Switch the pet selection view on pick friend screen to a interactive horizontal carousel layout. (why: Adoption step has the lowest non-finish completion rate at 69.8%, needing a smoother visual browsing experience.)
6: [finish, copy] Desktop pet taskbar launch instructions copy: Update final screen text to instruct users directly on desktop taskbar tray icons and pet interactions. (why: Multiple support emails reported post-onboarding confusion on how to control or hide pets on the desktop.)
7: [choose_path, layout] Choose path compact card layout: Change choose path screen layout to compact mode to streamline option scanning. (why: Reducing friction on choose path (mean 514s) helps users move into pet setup faster.)
8: [choose_path, layout] Interactive story scroll onboarding intro layout: Update the initial story screen layout to story_scroll for an engaging visual intro before choosing a creation path. (why: Setting clearer expectations early improves overall funnel completion (currently 26.9%).)
